selection_provenance.development_result: CDL-D/100 ns and CDL-E/100 ns each decoded conventional 10/10 and NeuralRx 10/10 at 30 dB; A/B/C results remain preserved and are not pooled

payload_and_slot: fresh payload each trial; slot cycles 0 through 19

acceptance.structural: exactly 250 paired records per model with declared strata, seeds, varying slots, and no runtime error
acceptance.high_snr_pipeline: at 10 dB, conventional >=49/50 and NeuralRx >=49/50 for each model
acceptance.conditional_value: over the four low-SNR strata, at least five NeuralRx-only correct TBs for each model
acceptance.reporting: report both-correct, NeuralRx-only, conventional-only, and neither for every stratum; do not use truth as an online policy input

claim_if_pass: Finite-sample compatibility and conditional recovery value only for the frozen Sionna CDL-D/E mode; no TDL-A, field-IQ, WCET, or production-HARQ generalization.
